map.输入镜头焦距 f 与有效孔径 D，按 N = f/D 计算光圈数（F 值），并可: Enter lens focal length f and effective aperture D; compute F-number (F value) by N = f/D, and reverse-calculate light intake and DOF at different apertures. For photography exposure and optical design.
map.由焦距与有效孔径，按 N = f/D 计算摄影镜头光圈数。: From focal length and effective aperture, compute the photographic lens F-number by N = f/D.
map.由焦距与口径算 F 数（F=f/D）。: Find F-number from focal length and aperture (F = f/D).
map.F 数决定进光量与景深。: The F-number determines light intake and depth of field.
map.通光面积∝1/F²。: Clear aperture area is proportional to 1/F^2.
map.：焦距 50mm、口径 25mm → F=50/25=2.0（F2 大光圈）；口: : focal length 50 mm, aperture 25 mm -> F = 50/25 = 2.0 (F2 large aperture); aperture 12.5 mm -> F = 4.0.
map.：F2→F4 口径减半、进光量降 1/4（差 2 档）；F 数每×√2 进光减半: : F2->F4 aperture halves, light intake drops 1/4 (2 stops); each F-number x sqrt(2) halves light, DOF deepens.
map.对。F=f/D，D 大则 F 小、进光多、景深浅，背景虚化强。: Yes. F = f/D; larger D means smaller F, more light, shallower DOF, stronger background blur.
map.F 数大（小口径）景深深、前后都清；F 数小景深浅、虚化强。: Large F-number (small aperture) gives deep DOF, front and back sharp; small F-number gives shallow DOF, strong bokeh.
